content.title: SST Launch Schedule - NASA
content.text: Realizing Rapid, Reduced-cost high-Risk Research (R5) R5 (S3/S5): Launch is anticipated in 2026 R5 (S9): Launch is anticipated in 2026 Green Propulsion Dual Mode (GPDM) Launch is anticipated in 2026 CubeSat Laser Infrared CrosslinK (CLICK) CLICK B/C launch is anticipated no earlier than Q2 2026 Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability (SSPICY) Launch is anticipated in late 2026 Technology Demonstration Missions Launched in 2025 Realizing Rapid, Reduced-cost high-Risk Research (R5) R5 (S2/S7) launched on November 28, 2025, aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket as part of the Transporter-15 rideshare mission from Space Launch Complex 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. DiskSat Launched on December 18, 2025, aboard a Rocket Lab Electron rocket from the company’s Launch Complex 2 on Wallops Island, Virginia. Technology Demonstration Missions Launched in 2024 PY4 (Four CubeSat Swarm of PYCubed-Based Spacecraft) Launched on March 4, 2024, aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-10 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Advanced Composite Solar Sail System (ACS3) Launched on April 23, 2024, aboard a Rocket Lab Electron rocket from the company’s Launch Complex 1 in Māhia, New Zealand. Realizing Rapid, Reduced-cost high-Risk Research (R5) R5 (S2/S4): Launched on July 3, 2024, aboard Firefly Aerospace’s Alpha rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Pathfinder Technology Demonstrator (PTD-4) Launched on August 16, 2024 aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-11 mission from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Pathfinder Technology Demonstrator (PTD-R) Launched on August 16, 2024 aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-11 mission from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Technology Demonstration Missions Launched in 2023 Starling Launched on July 17, 2023 from Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1 in New Zealand. Technology Demonstration Missions Launched in 2022 CubeSat Proximity Operations Demonstration (CPOD) Launched on May 25, 2022 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida aboard a Falcon 9 rocket as part of SpaceX’s Transporter-5 mission. Pathfinder Technology Demonstrator (PTD-3) Launched on May 25, 2022 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida aboard a Falcon 9 rocket as part of SpaceX’s Transporter-5 mission. Cislunar Autonomous Positioning System Technology Operations and Navigation Experiment (CAPSTONE) Launched on June 28, 2022 on Rocket Lab’s Electron rocket from the Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1 on the Mahia Peninsula of New Zealand. CubeSat Laser Infrared CrosslinK (CLICK) CLICK A launched on July 14, 2022 and deployed from the International Space Station on September 6, 2022 Lunar Flashlight Launched on December 11, 2022, from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
